scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Workers with a Visually, Physically or Mentally Disabled Child- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
The disabled child must be a dependent of the registered worker and listed on the worker's ESI Card or Ration Card
Child must have a disability percentage between 70% and 100% (blind, mentally retarded, mute, deaf)
Child must have no source of income and must be unmarried
No fixed service period requirement for the worker
Worker must not have already availed the benefit for the same dependent child in the relevant financial year
Worker must submit an annual living certificate for the dependent child indicating no income and unmarried status
benefits_summary: Annual financial assistance of ₹20,000 for disabled children with 70‑90% disability and ₹30,000 for children with 91‑100% disability.
documents_required: Living certificate of the dependent child (annual)
